def main():
    s = input().strip()
    n = len(s)
    ans = [s[0]]
    replaced_at = False
    i = 1
    while i < n:
        if i + 3 < n and s[i:i+3] == "dot":
            ans.append(".")
            i += 3
            continue
        if s[i] == 'a' and i + 1 < n - 1 and s[i+1] == 't' and not replaced_at:
            ans.append('@')
            replaced_at = True
            i += 2
            continue
        ans.append(s[i])
        i += 1
    print(''.join(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
